resources.string: Chess Arrows needs the "Display over other apps" permission to draw arrows over your chess app.

1. Enable the switch.
2. Open your chess app.
3. Tap the pencil and drag to draw an arrow.
4. Draw an L for a knight move.
5. Tap ↺ to undo, ✓ to finish.
Overlay permission required: enable the switch to configure it.
How to set up the board
Chess Arrows places a small floating pencil over your chess app. Draw moves, threats and ideas without leaving the game.
Tap the pencil to start drawing. Drag to create arrows. Release to place.
Use the undo button to remove the last arrow. Use the clear button to remove all arrows.
Adjust color, width and opacity in the settings. Changes apply immediately.
The overlay works over any chess app. No accessibility service needed.
Tap the switch to enable the overlay. Grant permission when prompted.
